product_risk_or_requirement: High-risk civic summaries can be unsupported, decontextualized, or published without accountable human review
current_state: Fixed corpus and citation design are proposed but no end-to-end grounding and approval evidence exists.
product_requirement: The product must withhold any high-risk civic summary unless each material claim links to an approved source and an editor records approval or correction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request concerns an election, violence, or emergency topic When the system cannot provide source support for every material claim Then it withholds the summary and queues the request; when support exists, publication requires a recorded editor approval.
evidence_needed: Claim-to-source audit sample; editor approval log; red-team results for unsupported and stale-source prompts.

product_risk_or_requirement: Political threats, hate speech, and removal decisions require timely local context and a meaningful reversal path
current_state: No local-expert roster, 15-minute escalation service level, or appeal procedure has been tested.
product_requirement: The operating model must give trained editors local-context evidence, authority to withhold or correct, and an appeal path for high-risk civic outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a credible high-risk political or violence signal is detected When the request is escalated Then a trained editor receives the source evidence and local-context checklist within 15 minutes, records a proportionate action, and exposes an appeal route.
deadline_or_trigger: Before release candidate and every election or violence-risk event
evidence_needed: Escalation drill results; local-expert availability record; sampled decision rationales and appeal outcomes.

jurisdiction: Vietnam privacy, content, and cross-border governance
product_risk_or_requirement: Reader-query data, potential personalization, and publishing duties are not legally confirmed for the exact product boundary
current_state: No approved data-flow map, legal opinion, or vendor-transfer assessment exists.
product_requirement: Legal and privacy owners must approve data collection, retention, vendor transfers, and a statement of prohibited political profiling before any real-user processing or publication.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final data flow and vendor list are complete When legal and privacy review is performed Then the owners approve retention, transfer, and content governance controls and confirm that political profiling and ad targeting remain disabled before release.
deadline_or_trigger: Before real-user data processing or external publication
evidence_needed: Signed launch memo; approved data-flow map; vendor assessment; deletion and no-profiling control test.

product_risk_or_requirement: Corpus and model changes can silently alter source quality, language coverage, or civic safety behavior
current_state: No change-control review or independent audit is in place.
product_requirement: Every material corpus, model, vendor, or policy change must trigger re-testing of grounding, high-risk escalation, and group-specific error checks before scope expansion.
acceptance_criteria: Given a material corpus, model, vendor, or policy change is proposed When release review begins Then the change is blocked until the owner attaches regression results and independent reviewer approval for the affected risk categories.
deadline_or_trigger: Any material corpus, model, vendor, policy, election, or market change
evidence_needed: Change-control record; regression suite report; independent reviewer approval.
